## Game Length Explorer

Use the search bar below to search for any video game, compare playtimes across playstyles, or sort by review score.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Load data and select key columns for display
games <- read_csv("howlongtobeat.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

games |>
  select(
    Game = game_name,
    Year = release_year,
    `Score` = review_score,
    `Main Story (hrs)` = main_story_hours,
    `Main + Extras (hrs)` = main_extra_hours,
    `Completionist (hrs)` = completionist_hours
  ) |>
  datatable(
    options = list(pageLength = 10, autoWidth = TRUE),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```
